description: This file contains functions and configurations for setting up IPv4-in-IPv6 tunnels, specifically for ds-lite and ipip6 protocols, including initialization, setup, and teardown procedures.

methods.name: tnl_setup
methods.description: Sets up a tunnel with specified configuration, including IP addresses, routing, and protocol-specific options.

methods.name: init_config
methods.description: Initializes common configuration parameters for tunnel protocols.

methods.name: proto_ipip6_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration specific to ipip6 tunnels.

methods.name: proto_ipip6_setup
methods.description: Sets up an ipip6 tunnel with provided configuration.

methods.name: proto_dslite_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration specific to ds-lite tunnels.

methods.name: proto_dslite_setup
methods.description: Sets up a ds-lite tunnel with predefined addresses.
